CustomField.formula:
/* uncomment next and last 2 lines to handle negatives and denote them in accounting style -1234 == (1,234.00) From - https://developer.salesforce.com/forums/?id=906F00000008utHIAQ */
IF(Order_Type__c <>'Credit', SUBSTITUTE( IF(VALUE(C2SPRC__c) < 0, "(", "") & /* uncomment and adjust currency sign */ "$" & IF(ABS(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c) / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF(ABS(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)/ 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c))), 3) /* multiplier x100 and 2 indicate number of decimal places */ & "." & RIGHT(TEXT(ROUND(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)* 100, 0)), 2) & IF(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)< 0, ")", "") ,"-","") , SUBSTITUTE( IF(VALUE(C2SPRC__c) > 0, "(", "") & /* uncomment and adjust currency sign */ "$" & IF(ABS(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c) / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF(ABS(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)/ 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(VALUE(C2SPRC__c))), 3) /* multiplier x100 and 2 indicate number of decimal places */ & "." & RIGHT(TEXT(ROUND(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)* 100, 0)), 2) & IF(VALUE(C2SPRC__c)> 0, ")", "") ,"-","") ) +'/'+ IF(Unit_of_Measure__c ='FT','Mft',Unit_of_Measure__c)
CustomField.label: SalesPricePortal
